# Battery-certificate fixtures

**These texts are synthetic.** They follow the layout of the Moba "Certificat batterie" as stored after redaction (`[VIN]`, `[IMMAT]`), with invented values and an invented link on `example.test`. Real certificate texts go in `real/`, which is git-ignored: they name the car model and the diagnostic place, and older stored copies carried a link to an unredacted PDF.
